sources.title: Qwen 3.6-35B-A3B: 73.4% SWE-bench With Only 3B Active Params — Runs on ...
sources.snippet: Alibaba released Qwen 3.6-35B-A3B on April 15, 2026 — the first open-weight model in the Qwen 3.6 generation. It’s a sparse Mixture-of-Experts model with 35 billion total parameters but only 3 billion active at inference time.
